features.title: Project skeleton with FastAPI backend and React/Vite frontend
acceptance: Backend FastAPI app runs and serves /health endpoint
Frontend React app builds and serves via Vite dev server
Docker compose with backend, frontend, and Keycloak services
Basic CI workflow runs backend and frontend tests

features.title: Incremental index updates with content hashing
acceptance: Node-level content hashing detects changed sections between document versions
Affected subtree rebuild only, not full tree
Parent summaries recomputed along impacted paths
Document version history maintained

features.title: Per-call chat usage measurement across protocols
acceptance: Individual model-call records preserved with identity
Complete/partial/unknown measurement states distinguished
Cache-read, cache-write, reasoning quantities retained
Measurements accessible on success, failure, cancellation

features.title: Fix get_leaf_nodes KeyError on leaf nodes
acceptance: get_leaf_nodes safely handles nodes without 'nodes' key
Returns leaf nodes correctly
Consistent with .get() pattern used elsewhere

features.title: Pydantic validation for LLM JSON outputs
acceptance: Pydantic models validate LLM responses against schemas
Malformed responses detected early with clear errors
Applied to key output formats in indexing pipeline

features.title: Fix TypeError: unsupported operand for int + NoneType in TOC processing
acceptance: add_page_offset_to_toc_json handles None page values
Graceful handling of missing page numbers
No crash on incomplete TOC data
